framework_lessons: Separate crisis lending from monetary stance.
assessment: The strongest elements are the LDI mechanics, early identification of adjacent-market stress, and concrete Lightning development. A broad claim that indebted central banks could not stop purchases is contradicted by ECB runoff and the BoE emergency-portfolio unwind. Bitcoin met its three-year direction; gold/miner sensitivities were strong but most gold preferences lacked fixed horizons. The article acknowledges an earlier gold timing miss. Physical-delivery and UK crypto-flow assertions still require the original datasets; investment and board roles in Bitcoin businesses are disclosed and should remain visible.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
